name: ENOMAKER (Shenzhen Enomaker Technology Co., Ltd.)
summary: Shenzhen-based Amazon filament brand whose ENOMAKER trademark (US application filed 2018-08-31, covering 3D-printing filaments) is held by Shenzhen Enomaker Technology Co., Ltd. Current range is Bambu-compatible spoolless PLA refills with RFID, matte PLA and silk PLA+. No OEM relationship is known.

product_lines.name: PLA Basic Refill (Bambu AMS)
product_lines.notes: 1 kg spoolless refill with RFID for AMS; colour names copy Bambu's; $24-25/kg.

additional_notes: Store is Amazon US, also resold through Desertcart and Ubuy; no brand website verified (enomaker.com unconfirmed). The 2018 trademark makes it older than most Amazon-first newcomers; the Bambu-refill range is a recent line extension. No evidence it rebrands a catalog extruder, so oem_relationships is empty.

provenance.conflicts: Trademark record read on Justia 2026-11-06 (ENOMAKER, serial 88100013, registered 2019-09-17, Class 17 filament, owner Shenzhen Enomaker Technology Co., Ltd., Longhua District, Shenzhen). Manufacturing origin unknown (China likely, not evidenced); no first-party site read.
